meta.title: Card Board
meta.description: Boards of small cards and charts that your own scripts keep up to date. Each person sees only the boards they're allowed to.

ui.title: Boards
ui.emptyHint: A board shows up here once the board command lists it, or a script writes its board.json into the data folder.
ui.noCards: This board has no cards yet.
ui.commandFailed: The board command “{command}” isn’t working, so its boards can’t be shown:
ui.commandFailedQuiet: The board command “{command}” isn’t working, so its boards can’t be shown.
ui.error.notFound: This board isn’t there any more.
ui.error.gone: This action isn’t on the card any more.
ui.error.noProvider: Boards need a sign-in plugin that says who is asking, and none is running.
ui.rowGone: This item is no longer on the card.
ui.readOnly.hint: You can see this board, but only the people it belongs to can press its buttons
ui.arrange.resetHint: Back to the order this board comes with
ui.arrange.raisedWhy: Time matters for this card right now, so it sits above the rest
ui.arrange.resetDone: Order reset to the board’s own
